title: Hive Box Facial Recognition Locks Bypassed With Printed Photos
summary: Facial-recognition lockers were easily bypassed by students using a printed photograph of the intended recipient. The vulnerability left delivery locker contents exposed to theft.

sources.title: Hive Box Facial-Recognition Locks Hacked by Fourth Graders Using Intended Recipient’s Facial Photo

title: Researchers demonstrate adversarial attack on Tesla Autopilot lane detection
summary: Tencent Keen Security Lab discovered that placing crafted stickers on roadways misled Tesla Autopilot into changing lanes improperly. Tesla downplayed the findings, stating the scenario was unrealistic in real-world driving conditions.

sources.title: Tesla Autopilot’s Lane Recognition Allegedly Vulnerable to Adversarial Attacks
